full_beta_binomial.scope: Full splicing analysis from existing real junction/event files, including input validation, filtering, R/glmmTMB fits, aggregation, observed PSI and TSV output. No BAM counting, plotting, or Excel export.
full_beta_binomial.measurement: Sampled PSS summed across Python, R master and all worker processes. Includes shared pages proportionally rather than counting them once per worker. Kernel and filesystem-cache charges are not included.

scope.observed: All 159204 events, 65 samples, production factorial input validation and observed_psi; retains all per-event-type output tables and PSI matrix.
scope.fisher: All 159204 input events; 129984 valid group-PSI events tested. WT background fad=0, ptbp2ko=0 (9 samples) versus ptbp2ko=1 (10 samples). Uses legacy read_junctions and production Fisher functions. Group counts are summed with NumPy; does not execute the complete legacy psi.py pipeline or retain its per-sample PSI outputs.

limitations: 32 worker processes shared four allocated CPUs; this is not a 32-CPU performance or full-concurrency memory benchmark.
No complete beta-binomial fitting, legacy pipeline, BAM counting, plotting or Excel export rerun. These are measurements of the newly optimized stages, not an end-to-end pipeline memory guarantee.
Polling reports observed peaks, not a hard upper bound. PSS avoids counting shared pages repeatedly; it excludes some job-level kernel and file-cache charges.
